issues.issue: Whole supplementary schedule left out (detail[] and detail_totals[] are empty). The notes give the reason: the schedule mixes fund types. But most receipt lines are clearly governmental, and the schedule can be recorded with fund 'Total primary government', the mixed 'Other' line flagged for review, and Transfers In 135,418 put in other financing.

issues.issue: Disbursement side of the budget schedule left out. The page prints it under separate Governmental and Business-Type Activities headings, so the fund-type reason in the notes doesn't apply here. These lines include transfers (e.g. General Government 210,004 vs 112,028 on p6), so transfers would need to go in other financing or be flagged.

issues.on_page: LVRPPD/Black Hills Energy 65,110 (p3 label: LVRPPD/Black Hills Energy/NCTC)
issues.issue: Payments from a power district, a gas utility and a telephone company to a village are usually franchise or occupation fees, so occupation/franchise tax probably fits better than other taxes. Kept as a warning because the report doesn't say. The line is already flagged for review.
